messages:
maya: Quick status check — sprint goal is the latency cutover for the kernel v2 path. Short checklist: (1) kernel PR landed? owner @adrian (2) continuous-batching e2e green? owner @samir (3) KV handshake prefetch fix deployed? owner @elena. Any blockers? Also need code review pings for kernel PR #4521 and sign-off for canary. ETA for canary expansion? :eyes:

adrian: Kernel PR #4521 was merged to feature/kernel-v2 yesterday but I rolled it back due to a regression on long-context throughput (~2.5x worse CPU/token). Repro steps in the PR comment. I'm bisecting now — suspecting a matmul kernel fallback after the scheduling tweak. @samir can you repro with batch=16 / seq=4096?

samir: I ran the e2e harness against adrian's branch. Batch=16 / seq=4096 shows throughput drop, logs below:
```
[2026-03-16 02:12:01] batch_worker: token_throughput=34 tok/s (baseline 86)
[2026-03-16 02:12:04] kv_cache: eviction_rate=0.03
```
I filed issue #879. Will run a profile build and upload a flamegraph (sharing link here when ready).

elena: KV handshake fix (race in prefetch) is in canary on prod-us-west-2 (deploy id: deploy-2026-03-16-77). Saw a few 5xx during the first 10m and rolled back auto-burst; patch is at PR #4578. Plan: keep at 25% then monitor latency heatmap and error rate. cc @maya for rollback windows.

maya: Thanks. Priorities: we need the kernel regression fixed before expanding canary. Adrian — estimate for bisect + patch? Samir — please attach flamegraph when ready. Elena — hold canary at 25% unless SLA breaches.

adrian: Bisect narrowed it to commit 9f3a2 (scheduling tweak in attention kernel). I have a branch with the targeted fix and local tests passing. Opened PR #4583 with the revert + patch. Requesting 1 reviewer from eng-runtime and 1 from eng-platform for perf sign-off. ETA EOD PST if nothing else pops up.

samir: Flamegraph uploaded to the perf board: https://redwood.internal/perf/boards/1782. Also spotted a memcopy hotspot in batching logic — I'll include a micro-optimization in a separate PR; it shouldn't block adrian's fix but might help overall latency. Tagging @elena for any KV interactions.

maya: OK — @adrian please ping @samir once PR is ready so he can run the e2e harness. @elena hold the canary at 25% and share trace ids for any 5xx. I'll prep a short sync note for product + infra.

ci-bot: Build queued for PR #4583 — job: perf-checker-3. Expected ~22m.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy started for PR #4578 (KV prefetch). Target=25% prod-us-west-2. Monitor: /monitoring/latency/kv-prefetch. Auto-rollback if regressions > 2x baseline in 10m.

elena: Added trace ids for the 5xx spikes: trace:ab12, trace:ab13 — both map to canary instances with an older runtime image (image rotation race?). Pinning image and will restart the canary instances now.

maya: Action items summary:
- adrian: land #4583 + ping samir
- samir: perf profile + micro-opt PR
- elena: pin canary image + monitor traces
If any of you see >1.5x latency regressions, drop a note here and I'll escalate.
